cautions.en: Reported prices vary between sources ($540/year via one figure, ~$440-520/year via others); revalidate the current figure directly on autodesk.com before publishing, since direct access was blocked during this research.
A 30-day return policy applies to annual/multi-year subscriptions; monthly subscriptions have a 15-day return window.

Aimed at small teams and freelancers who need basic CAD without 3D modeling tools

limitations.en: No 3D modeling toolset, unlike the full AutoCAD subscription
No permanent free tier, only a 15-day trial
